About CODEM

Clear organisation.
A human touch.

A move involves many individual tasks. Our role is to organise them around your needs.

CODEM supports households and businesses moving to or from Paris, Greater Paris, France and Europe. Preparation, protection, handling, transport and installation are coordinated according to the agreed services.

We start by understanding your situation, the belongings to move and site constraints. Then we agree suitable resources and services together.
